summary: Ubuntu 15.04 (Vivid Vervet) was released on 23 April 2015. Features: systemd as default init system (replacing Upstart), DDoS mitigation in the kernel, improved power management, newer graphics stack. The vervet monkey suggested liveliness and sociability.
notes: Unsupported since 2016-02-04. Kernel 4.2. Major change: systemd replaced Upstart. This aligned Ubuntu with most other Linux distros.
